en: The postcard features two sides: the front shows a black-and-white photograph of a bustling town square with people, market stalls, and prominently ornate, classical European buildings. In the square's background, a large domed building is visible, and there is a tall church spire with a clock. Text in the image identifies the scene as 'Sundsvall. Torget.' The reverse side features handwritten correspondence in Swedish, an address section, a Swedish postage stamp, and cancellation marks from Sundsvall.
